title: Nodes - markdown notes for macOS
excerpt: A markdown writing app for macOS. Your notes are plain .md files on your own disk, linked with double brackets and searched on your own machine.
content_html:
Nodes 2.0

Full launch

August 2026

Munich, Germany

Every piece of feedback, each mail you send us, truly meant the world for us and shaped the path we took to get here. And here we are now, all around the globe using Nodes, every inked country on this globe held at least one early supporter before launch day. And for those people who were here before anyone asked them to be - we will never forget, Nodes will be yours, free. Forever.

Welcome to Nodes - a minimal, beautiful, and fast writing app for macOS. Built for those who care about both form and function, Nodes is a place to write, think, and create without distraction. Every design decision is intentional. Every element earns its place. Designed for macOS, it blends powerful technology with a quiet, focused experience.

Write with clarity. Full markdown support lets you focus on your words while maintaining beautiful structure. Headers, lists, code blocks - all rendered elegantly without getting in your way.

DEMO free try it - the editor whole, 16 nodes and 4 tags

ALEXANDRIA $12.99 the library - no caps, import & export, graph settings

ROSETTA $17.99 the intelligence - everything, plus the agent

Prices shown are US App Store prices; your own storefront may differ.

[[what each plan holds]]

Find anything, instantly. Full-text search runs from your very first note, on every plan: start typing and every word you have written is already being matched. Searching by meaning is the Rosetta half - describe an idea in your own words and the note about it comes up even when you never wrote those words down, because the model on your Mac has read the library and knows what the notes are about. It can only find what it has already been through, so a library it has just met fills in while you work. Both kinds of search happen on your machine; nothing is sent away to be looked up.

Your thoughts stay with you. Everything runs on-device, private and secure. No cloud dependencies, no data harvesting. Just you and your words, exactly as it should be. Your notes are plain markdown files on your own disk, which is true on every plan and is why the library outlives the app. Alexandria adds the moving parts around them: Import & Export for whole folders and the portable .nodes archive, and a daily snapshot to restore from when a morning goes wrong. Without it Nodes keeps no recovery points at all - the files are still yours, and copying them out by hand is always yours to do. So you can always walk away with everything.

content_html_zh:
Nodes 2.0

全面启动

2026 年 8 月

德国慕尼黑

您发送给我们的每一条反馈、每封邮件都对我们来说真正意味着世界，并塑造了我们到达这里的道路。 现在，我们在全球范围内使用 Nodes，全球每个有墨迹的国家/地区在发布日之前都至少拥有一名早期支持者。 对于那些在任何人要求之前就来到这里的人 - 我们永远不会忘记，节点将是你的，免费的。 永远。

欢迎使用 Nodes - 一款简约、美观且快速的 macOS 编写应用程序。 Nodes 专为那些同时关心形式和功能的人而打造，是一个可以心无旁骛地写作、思考和创造的地方。 每个设计决定都是有意的。 每个元素都赢得了自己的位置。 它专为 macOS 设计，将强大的技术与安静、专注的体验融为一体。

写清楚。 全面的降价支持让您专注于文字，同时保持美观的结构。 标题、列表、代码块 - 所有这些都优雅地呈现，不会妨碍您。

DEMO 免费试用 - 整个编辑器，16 个节点和 4 个标签

ALEXANDRIA $12.99 图书馆 - 无上限、导入和导出、图形设置

ROSETTA $17.99 情报 - 一切，加上代理

显示的价格为美国 App Store 价格；您自己的店面可能会有所不同。

[[每个计划包含什么]]

立即找到任何东西。 全文搜索从您的第一个笔记开始，在每个计划中运行：开始输入，您写的每个单词都已经匹配。 按含义搜索是 Rosetta 的一半 - 用您自己的话描述一个想法，即使您从未写下这些单词，有关该想法的注释也会出现，因为 Mac 上的模型已经阅读了库并知道注释的内容。 它只能找到它已经经历过的内容，因此它刚刚遇到的库会在您工作时填充。 两种搜索都发生在您的计算机上；没有任何东西被发送出去以供查找。

你的想法与你同在。 一切都在设备上运行，私密且安全。 没有云依赖，没有数据收集。 只有你和你的话，正如它应该的那样。 您的笔记是您自己磁盘上的纯 Markdown 文件，这在每个计划中都是如此，也是该库比应用程序寿命更长的原因。 Alexandria 添加了围绕它们的移动部件：整个文件夹的导入和导出以及可移植的 .nodes 存档，以及在早上出错时恢复的每日快照。 如果没有它，节点根本不会保留任何恢复点 - 文件仍然是您的，并且手动将它们复制出来始终是您的事情。 所以你可以随时带走一切。
